title: Tensor product of polynomial rings
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $I,J$ sets. The $R$-algebra map $R[X_i:i\in I]\otimes_RR[Y_j:j\in J]\to R[X_i,Y_j:i\in I,j\in J]$ (polynomial ring in the disjoint union of the variables), $f\otimes g\mapsto fg$, is an isomorphism; it sends $X_i\otimes1\mapsto X_i$ and $1\otimes Y_j\mapsto Y_j$. By induction, for finite sets $I_1,\dots,I_n$, $R[X_{I_1}]\otimes_R\cdots\otimes_RR[X_{I_n}]\cong R[X_{I_1\sqcup\dots\sqcup I_n}]$, the $k$-th factor's variables going to the corresponding variables.
